note: Private campground at the Falls of Blaine Creek in Fallsburg, north of Louisa. One row of sites overlooks the falls pool across the campground's sand beach; the B sites run along the creek. Five camping cabins, an efficiency apartment, a footbridge to a small island, playgrounds. --Claude
summary: Kept. $36.50-43 re-read on the operator prices page (undated, © 2022) with +$5 holidays/events and $5 per person over 4; 30/50A, water, 17 sewer, ~100 sites, showers/2 dumps/wifi; phone booking only. Google 4.6/291. Price gate passes; transient (daily/weekly only). Riverview kept; B-row creekside lead.
flags: PRICE GATE passes: cheapest RV night $36.50 (30A) on https://www.fallscampground.com/prices.html, read 2026-11-23. The rates carry no date and the site's footer says © 2022 (events page lists 2022 events) - the posting may be stale, but RV Life's $$ tier (stored) agrees it is well under $50. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false); stored military true is from the Good Sam directory - not stated on the operator pages, left alone.
GOOGLE: 'The Falls Campground' 4.6 stars, 291 reviews, phone 606-826-0212 (matches stored), read 2026-11-23. Presence passes (working website with phone).

LONG-STAY: operator sells daily and weekly only (no monthly or seasonal rates anywhere on the site); test 2 passes. Imagery shows some sites in the north loop with sheds/decks (possible long-stayers), but nothing on the operator's pages points to seasonal sales.

WATERFRONT: stored riverview KEPT. The A row at the pin (A15-A21 on the operator map; 38.1779,-82.6744) sits ~50-55 m from the falls pool across grass and the campground's own sand beach ('a wonderful spot to soak up some sun or wade', i.e. a used beach - a buffer), pads ~4.5 m above the water (3DEP 170.4 m vs ~165.9 m): a view. CREEKSIDE LEAD (not proposed as a change): the operator map draws B1-B13 directly along Blaine Creek, which is ~18-20 m wide upstream of the pool (3DEP cross-section at 38.17868,-82.6730: creek bed 165.8 m between banks at ~168.1 m). On Esri the north loop's open grass (around 38.1786,-82.6734) reaches the creek's bank, which carries a band of trees; the bank is ~2.3 m high over ~6 m. Individual B pads can't be placed from imagery (the map is schematic), so the creekside upgrade for B1-B13 is left for a human look at site photos.

Replacement waterfront evidence text: 'Operator map + Esri/3DEP 2026-11-23: A15-A21 overlook the falls pool ~50 m off across the campground's sand beach, pads ~4.5 m above the water (riverview); B1-B13 drawn along Blaine Creek (~18-20 m wide, wooded 2.3 m bank) - unconfirmed creekside'.
